newsitem.title: UK: Union expects 1,000 Kwik Save jobs to go.
newsitem.headline: Union expects 1,000 Kwik Save jobs to go.

text.p: British shopworkers' trade union Usdaw said it expected 1,000 job losses among full- and part-time workers at Kwik Save's stores following the discount supermarket chain's decision to close 107 stores.
About 1,900 people work in the 107 shops to be shut.

Kwik Save Finance director Derek Pretty told Reuters in an interview that the closure programme would involve less than 200 job losses as 90 percent of the staff would be redeployed in Kwik Save's remaining 874 outlets.
The union, which represents more than 8,000 Kwik Save managers and shopfloor staff, said it would be seeking talks with the company to find ways of reducing the impact on workers.
"We had expected some announcement from Kwik Save, but we are devastated by the scale of the planned closures," said Usdaw National Officer Val Pugh. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
